agents.lead: The MCP server is built into the app. Add it to Claude Code, Codex, opencode or any MCP client, then ask your agent to open a menu, read the screen or run a test, and watch it work.
agents.note: Settings → API & MCP in the app shows the exact configuration for your computer. Tools and HTTP API.
agents.t1: 23 MCP tools and an HTTP API on your own computer.
agents.t2: You see every agent action live, as it happens.
agents.t3: One switch blocks agent input whenever you want.
agents.title: Let agents play, test and explore

connect.board.text: Luckfox, Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W, Pi 4/5. Every button, including C, GL and GR in Pro Controller mode. Keyboard and mouse too. The app installs it over SSH.
connect.board.title: Linux board
connect.ch9329.text: A keyboard and mouse for the console, no controller.
connect.ch9329.title: CH9329
connect.lead: The console's HDMI goes into a USB capture card on your computer. For input, a small device plugs into the console's USB port. Pick the one that suits you.
connect.pico.text: The cheapest controller option, with a 3.3 V USB-to-UART adapter. Keyboard and mouse too. The app flashes the firmware for you.
connect.pico.title: Raspberry Pi Pico
connect.title: Eyes and hands
connect.view.text: Just a capture card: watch, record, take screenshots and read text.
connect.view.title: View only
download.device.title: Input device
download.lead: The newest release for every computer. The app tells you when there is a new one.
download.note: First launch on macOS or Windows may show a warning: see the FAQ. Windows and Linux also need ffmpeg: the setup guide shows how.
download.title: Download
faq.lead: Answers about setup, capture, input devices, the offline network, agents and updates.
faq.meta_description: Answers about NS2Bench setup, capture, input devices, the offline network, agents and updates.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
features.agents.text: An HTTP API, an MCP server with 34 tools and a command line tool. Agents can wait for the screen to react and find text on it. You see every agent action live, and one switch blocks agent input.
features.agents.title: Let agents drive
features.drive.text: Keyboard, mouse or your own gamepad, through a small input device on the console's USB port. On-screen Joy-Con light up with every press.
features.drive.title: Drive
features.lead: Everything a TV sees and a controller presses, on your computer. Nothing is installed on the console and nothing is uploaded.
features.offline.text: An optional console network answers only the connectivity test. No forwarding, no NAT, no internet, and that can't be turned off.
features.offline.title: Offline by design
features.see.text: 1080p60 video and sound from any USB HDMI capture card. Screenshots, 30-second clips and on-screen text reading. On macOS it shares the card with OBS.
features.see.title: See and hear
features.test.text: Repeatable JSON tests with screenshots and a clip of the moments before any failure. Logs say what went wrong and what to do, and notifications tell you when something needs you.
features.test.title: Test
features.title: Your Switch 2, on your desk
features.yours.text: Light, Peach, Dark and OLED themes, text size and accessibility options, and 11 languages. Free and open source under the GPL-3.0 license.
features.yours.title: Yours
foot.made: Created by PhantomPtr. NS2Bench is free software under the GPL-3.0 license.
foot.nintendo: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo. Nintendo Switch is a trademark of Nintendo.
hero.fine: For macOS, Windows and Linux. You need a USB HDMI capture card; an input device is optional. No jailbreak needed: works with any Switch 2, stock or jailbroken.
hero.lead: By hand or by AI agents. Live video and sound, keyboard, mouse and gamepad input, and repeatable tests. The console stays offline.
hero.title: See, hear and drive a Nintendo Switch 2 from your computer.
meta.description: Free, open-source bench for the Nintendo Switch 2: live video and sound, keyboard, gamepad and AI-agent input through a USB input device, repeatable tests. The console stays offline.
meta.og: See, hear and drive a Nintendo Switch 2 from your computer, by hand or by AI agents. The console stays offline.
meta.title: NS2Bench · See, hear and drive a Nintendo Switch 2 from your computer

tour.settings.t1: The Video panel lists only what your card offers. Sound comes through the same card.
tour.settings.t2: Input settings change without restarting the app.
tour.settings.t3: Updates are checked daily and verified before they install.
tour.settings.text: Pick the capture card and the input device in Settings. The doctor checks every part and tells you what to fix.
tour.settings.title: Set up in minutes
tour.yours.t1: Four themes: Light, Peach, Dark and OLED.
tour.yours.t2: 11 languages, the same as this site.
tour.yours.t3: Clips, screenshots and logs stay on your computer.
tour.yours.text: The app looks and speaks the way you like, and remembers it.
